prompt: Create a dark, cinematic fine-art portrait in vertical 9:16 format: a young woman with dark curly hair and olive skin is encased from the shoulders up inside a perfectly clear glass cube filled with transparent amber liquid or resin. Her face is centered slightly right, calm and melancholic, eyes half open and looking forward, lips relaxed, with realistic skin texture and wet highlights. The glass cube has sharp visible edges, thick refractive corners, glossy reflections, tiny bubbles, ripples, and distorted light caustics across the surface. Inside and around the cube are delicate tangled green stems and botanical filaments, plus exactly 8 visible dark red cherries suspended at different depths: 3 on the left side, 1 near the lower center front, and 4 on the right side. The lower part of the image shows a second rounded glass vessel or pedestal beneath the cube, also filled with dark amber reflections and dripping liquid. Use an almost black background with warm golden bokeh, low-key chiaroscuro lighting, high contrast, rich brown and bronze tones, shallow depth of field, hyperrealistic photographic detail, dramatic editorial fashion mood, no text, no watermark, no extra faces.

promptZh: 创作一张 9:16 竖构图的暗黑电影感艺术肖像：一位拥有 深色卷发 和橄榄色皮肤的年轻女性，从肩膀以上被封存在一个完全透明的玻璃立方体中，立方体内充满透明的琥珀色液体或树脂。她的脸部略微偏右，神情平静而忧郁，双眼半睁并注视前方，双唇放松，呈现出逼真的皮肤质感和湿润的高光。玻璃立方体边缘清晰可见，折射角厚重，表面带有光泽反射、细小气泡、涟漪以及扭曲的光焦散效果。立方体内外缠绕着精致的绿色茎秆和植物纤维，并悬浮着 8 颗清晰可见的深红色樱桃：左侧 3 颗，下方正中附近 1 颗，右侧 4 颗。图像下部展示了立方体下方的一个圆形玻璃容器或底座，同样充满深琥珀色的反射和滴落的液体。使用近乎黑色的背景，搭配温暖的金色光斑，低调的明暗对照照明，高对比度，丰富的棕色和青铜色调，浅景深，超写实摄影细节，极具戏剧性的时尚编辑风格，无文字，无水印，无额外人脸。
